name: site.checkbox/checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Auto-renewal law checks (ROSCA, click-to-cancel, CA, NY) for subscription Stripe Checkout and emails

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients that implement MCP OAuth sign in without it (browser approval). Otherwise Bearer <Checkbox API key> (ck_test_… or ck_live_…).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Free checks of subscription checkouts, terms, cancellation flows and renewal emails against U.S. automatic-renewal laws (FTC ROSCA, California, New York and about 26 other states), with corrected Stripe Checkout parameters, disclosure text and email templates. Not legal advice.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Checkbox API key (ck_test_… or ck_live_…). Free at https://app.checkbox.site/sign-up
